name: Settlement cut off
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. The isolation is engineered for demonstration; it is not an observed cut-off event.
selection_rule: lowest-lying settlement point (village/hamlet/town) inside the island outline by DSM elevation, target level +1.5 m

perturbations.goal: no path from the settlement to any shelter

expected_effects: an explicit no-viable-evacuation state instead of a bogus route
assertions: disconnected flag matches a full reachability check
no route crosses water deeper than the threshold
the settlement appears in the hand-off list with population and reason
